title: Windows Lock Contention Hardening

evidence.claim: Linux Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 passed; Windows native failed in multiprocess Review Queue locking with PermissionError during exclusive lock creation.
PermissionError is classified as contention only when the lock path exists; otherwise genuine permission failure propagates fail-closed.
Deterministic tests cover Windows-style access-denied contention and genuine permission failure propagation.
Existing native multiprocess Review Queue writer test remains the production-level regression gate.
